why: Builds a repeatable shot from the ground up.
say: One hand, ball on your fingerpads, elbow under — shoot it straight up and in.
how: Stand 3 feet in front of the rim.
Shoot with your shooting hand only; guide hand behind your back.
Make 10, step back, repeat.

why: Shooting reps from every angle with built-in competition.
say: Make it from this spot to move to the next — go all the way around.
how: 7 spots around the arc (or closer for younger players).
Make it to move on; miss and you stay (or take a 'chance').
First around and back wins.
h: Must make 2 in a row to advance.

st: Make it from the first spot

why: High reps with a partner rebounding and passing.
say: Shoot, your partner rebounds and passes — move to a new spot every shot.
how: Shooter at a spot, partner under the rim.
Shoot, partner rebounds and passes to the shooter's new spot.
Switch after 10 shots or 1 minute.
h: Shooter must hit 5 in a row before switching.

say: Passer feeds the shooter, shooter gets their own rebound, then switch lines.
how: Shooting line on the wing, passing line at the top.
Pass, shooter catches ready and shoots.
Shooter rebounds and goes to the passing line; passer goes to the shooting line.
cue: Passer: lead pass to the shooting pocket

why: Shooting after movement, like in a game.
say: Pass to the wing, cut to the elbow, get it back and shoot.
how: Start at the top with the ball, passer on the wing.
Pass, cut hard to the elbow.
Receive the return pass and shoot. Rotate.
e: No cut — catch and shoot at the elbow.

why: Builds a reliable routine for free points.
say: Same routine every time: feet, dribbles, breath, shoot.
how: Each player picks a routine (e.g., 3 dribbles, breath, shoot).
Shoot 2, rotate to rebound, next shooter.
Track makes out of 10.
h: Run a sprint before each pair.

why: Builds range only as fast as form allows.
say: Make 3 from here to move back — miss twice and you move up.
how: Start 4 feet out.
Make 3 to move back one big step.
Miss twice in a row, move up one step.

say: Two passers keep feeding you — catch, shoot, find the next ball.
how: Shooter at the top or elbow.
Two passers under the rim, each with a ball.
Shoot, next pass comes immediately; 30–45 seconds.
h: Shooter moves to a new spot every shot.

why: Defense-to-offense: close out, slide, then sprint into a catch-and-shoot.
say: Close out at the elbow yelling 'ball ball ball', slide across, sprint around the cone, and shoot.
how: Line on the baseline; coach/passer on the baseline with the ball.
Close out to the elbow — 'ball ball ball!'
Defensive slide across the free-throw line.
Sprint out around the cone, catch the pass from the baseline, shoot. Switch sides.
h: Shoot off one dribble after the catch.

st: Close out at the elbow — 'ball ball ball!'

why: Nonstop shooting: nobody waits, everybody has a job.
say: Shooter, rebounder, passer. Shoot, move to a new spot, and the next ball is already coming.
how: Groups of three at a hoop with two balls: shooter, rebounder, passer.
Shooter shoots and moves to a new spot.
Passer hits the shooter; rebounder feeds the passer.
One minute, then rotate jobs.
h: Shooter must make two in a row to rotate.
var: Catch and shoot from five spots
Team total: count makes out loud and beat it next round

st: Rebounder grabs it while the passer hits the shooter at a new spot
Shoot again — the rebounder feeds the passer
Keep it going for a minute, then rotate jobs

why: Pairs shooting at every hoop with a score to beat.
say: Each cone is a hole. Count how many shots it takes to make one, then move on. Lowest score wins.
how: Set cone 'holes' around every hoop.
Pairs start at different holes; one shoots, one rebounds.
Count every shot until a make, then both move to the next hole.
Switch shooter each hole. Lowest total wins.
h: Max three shots per hole; a miss on the third is a 5.
var: Nine holes across every hoop in the gym
Partners alternate shots on the same hole
Play as a team scramble: best score counts

st: Both pairs shoot from their hole — count every shot
Missed? Shoot again from the same spot
Made it? Both partners move to the next hole
